source_contract.grid_derivation: The source launches one CTA per row. At most eight 256-thread CTAs reside on each of 132 SMs from the static thread, warp, register, shared-memory, and block limits, so grids through 1056 contain no queued CTA.

decision.reason: Same composition as the A800 reference; the H200 reference supplies only first/resident source-round service and no production duration.

excluded_conclusions: hidden sizes with a partial source round
queued CTA service or grids above 1056
per-shape timing interpolation or residual correction
